title: On Exploring the cave beyond the fall
subtitle: 科学探索 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）
meta: 主题语境：科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）　|　核心词汇：explore　|　正文 347 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 explore 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1981 the painter ① explored the cave beyond the fall twice over, and every visitor in the studio said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the painter ② explores the cave beyond the fall year after year without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ explore the cave beyond the fall at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ explored the cave beyond the fall before — a line in the catalogue for May 1975 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Exploring the cave beyond the fall twice over, the painter said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the brush at the far easel, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ explore every corner of the old house year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Explore every corner of the old house at once and never mention it again.

By 1988 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the catalogue, and a new visitor from the next studio ⑧ explores every corner of the old house twice over every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the easel, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ explored the cave beyond the fall again when nobody else would.

⑩ To explore the cave beyond the fall, my mother said in 1993, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the studio remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the studio forgets, somebody explores the cave beyond the fall year after year again and somebody must explore the cave beyond the fall twice over all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 勘探（一般过去式 explored the cave beyond the fall：1981 年画师头一回这样做，来回两遍）
B. v. 勘探（一般现在 explores the cave beyond the fall：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 勘探（不定式 to explore the cave beyond the fall：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 勘探（过去完成时 had explored the cave beyond the fall：1975 年五月的展品目录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 勘探（动名词 exploring the cave beyond the fall 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 探究（explore every corner of the old house：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去探究把老宅每个角落都探究过）
G. v. 探究（explore every corner of the old house：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 勘探（后段两处：新来的观者照例 explores every corner of the old house，而母亲又一次 explored the cave beyond the fall）

answers.why: explore 意为“勘探”，1981 年画师来回两遍勘探勘察瀑布那边那个洞，那是画室里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 explored。
explore 意为“勘探”，自那以后画师年年地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 explores。
explore 意为“勘探”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯勘探勘察瀑布那边那个洞”，此处为不定式 to explore the cave beyond the fall。
explore 意为“勘探”，展品目录里 五月 那行字说明早在 1988 年之前就有人勘探过，故用过去完成时 had explored。
explore 意为“勘探”，画师说“勘探勘察瀑布那边那个洞这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 exploring the cave beyond the fall 作主语。
explore 意为“探究”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去探究把老宅每个角落都探究过”，should ever 之后用原形 explore every corner of the old house。
explore 意为“探究”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻探究把老宅每个角落都探究过（explore every corner of the old house at once），以后再也不要提起。
explore 意为“勘探”，新来的观者每个季度都照例探究把老宅每个角落都探究过，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 explores。
explore 意为“勘探”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次来回两遍勘探勘察瀑布那边那个洞，用一般过去式 explored 叙述。
explore 意为“勘探”，结尾那句是母亲 1993 年的话：要勘探勘察瀑布那边那个洞，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和画室记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 explore 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1981 the painter explored the cave beyond the fall twice over, and nobody in the studio forgot it.
Even now the painter explores the cave beyond the fall year after year whenever the studio asks.
Exploring the cave beyond the fall twice over, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever explore every corner of the old house year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new visitor from the next studio explores every corner of the old house twice over every season, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother explored the cave beyond the fall again, and the studio remembered that half.
